basis: FEED-009 P1/P3: a zero-preserving multiplicative family with a concrete prime-derived multiplier is a testable alternative to the reproduced additive stream.
C017/C018: known-page F and continuous-clock semantics motivate registering F-consume and F-free branches, but do not establish this new family on unknown pages.
E009-short-scorer-calibration: the fixed unigram scorer passed its synthetic short-text tool calibration; its use here remains a lead detector, not plaintext acceptance.
hypothesis: Some rune-bearing LP2/0..55 pages are compatible with C_t = 2^(p_(t+1)-1) P_t mod29, with F represented by zero and either consuming or not consuming the clock under a fixed continuous or page-reset branch.
mechanistic_basis: For t>=1 the exponent p_(t+1)-1 is even, so the multiplier is a square in the nonzero field; t=0 is the preregistered first-position exception. The model preserves zero exactly and is not an additive prime-minus-one transform.
falsifiable_predictions: All 55 rune-bearing pages (12956 rune indices) are decoded under exactly four registered branches: continuous/page-reset x F-free/F-consume.

The observed length-normalized unigram score for at least one page/branch exceeds every family-wide page/branch maximum from 999 independent within-page permutation controls at adjusted p<=0.01, after the registered maxT correction, if the model leaves a language-aligned lead.

A complete scan with no adjusted lead is negative only for this exact multiplier, clock branches, scorer and permutation null; it does not reject other multiplicative, affine, exponent or key families.
Any arithmetic, source-coverage or control incompleteness is error/timeout/inconclusive, never negative. A score lead is not a decrypted page.
applicable_objects: All 55 LP2 pages containing registered rune tokens, including rune portions of mixed page LP2/49 and LP2/51.

excluded_objects.reason: Pinned page contains no registered rune tokens; literal alphanumeric grid is outside this rune-domain multiplier model and is retained as unexecuted, not negative.

representation: Original rune ordinal indices 0..28 only; zero is F and is never deleted or relabeled.
algorithm_version: H010-v1: a_t=2^(prime[t]-1) mod29; nonzero C decodes P=C*a_t^(-1) mod29 and consumes t; C=0 decodes P=0 and either consumes or leaves t fixed per branch.
parameter_derivation_policy: No keyword, affine shift, exponent enumeration, dictionary, output-selected mask or page-specific tuning. Only the stated base 2, prime sequence, clock continuity and F-consumption branches are evaluated.
page_and_section_continuity_hypothesis: Continuous branches carry t through LP2/0..55 in numeric order; page-reset branches start t=0 at every page. Literals and separators are outside the public rune sequence and do not consume t.

scorer_and_acceptance_version.score: Mean of fixed training-only unigram log weights over each page's decoded indices; no candidate-specific changes.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.controls: 999 independent Python MT19937 within-page permutations; one shuffled page per replicate is reused across all four branches, preserving page lengths and rune multisets.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.multiple_testing: Standardize each of 55*4 cells using observed plus controls; compare each observed z to the maximum z across all 220 cells in every control replicate. Adjusted p=(1+exceedances)/1000.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.lead: Complete controls and p<=0.01 with nonzero variance is an exploratory mechanism lead; it is inconclusive until an independent prediction and exact rune/key validation are supplied.
scorer_and_acceptance_version.decipherment: No page is accepted as solved from score, readable appearance, or reverse multiplication alone.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner stores specification, corpus/training hashes, branch list, control seed, page order and code snapshot before decoding observed pages or generating permutations.

total_budget.origin: Bounded local full-corpus diagnostic budget for auto-cycle R002; no side-chat budget inherited.

controls: 999 page-wise uniform permutations preserving every page's rune multiset and length.
Independent prime generation, modular inverse/decode, zero-clock handling, re-encryption and source-coverage audit.
H009 calibration is retained as a scorer qualification but no LP plaintext or answer is passed to the experiment.

randomness.role: Permutation controls only; never a key, plaintext or candidate parameter.

discovery_path: The experiment operates on public rune-index pages and fixed training counts; no language reference, expected plaintext or hidden key is available to the decoder.
independent_validation_path: A separate trial-division prime generator and separate modular replay re-compute every observed page/branch plaintext, terminal clock and re-encryption before any lead is reported.
correlated_transform_deduplication: The four clock/F branches are retained as preregistered branch cells; no additional exponent, base, coordinate or related projection is counted as an independent hit.
uncovered_parameters: additive prime stream already tested by H006/H007
transposition, alternate page order, literal/grid consumption
language ngrams beyond the frozen unigram and independent unseen LP plaintext
next_step: If a formal lead survives the maxT controls, retain it as inconclusive and register a new independent drilldown; otherwise choose the next method family without repeating these four branches.
note: This is a mechanism-level full-corpus diagnostic. A complete negative is scoped to the exact multiplicative stream and null, not to multiplicative cryptography in general.
